title: Angular Workshop
blurb: A hands-on signals workshop: live components, Twoslash types, Magic Move refactors and a runnable editor.

title: Signals Deep Dive
blurb: signal, computed, effect, linkedSignal, resource, model() and view queries, each running on its slide.

title: Forms and DI
blurb: Reactive and template-driven forms with @angular/forms, a root service shared across slides, host bindings and a directive in markdown.

title: Pipes and i18n
blurb: Angular's number, currency, date and text pipes in German, async and i18n pipes, and a custom pipe used straight from a slide.

title: Control Flow Torture
blurb: @if, @for, @switch, @let and @defer written straight into markdown, nested and mixed with tables, code and clicks.

title: Angular Animations and Styles
blurb: animate.enter and animate.leave, view encapsulation, per-slide styles and CSS animations on clicks.

title: Scaffold Flow
blurb: The deck `slide-ng create` gives you, grown into a short talk on signals.

title: Clicks Masterclass
blurb: Absolute and relative clicks, ranges, hide, nested lists, switches, fixed totals and click markers in notes.

title: Motion and Transitions
blurb: All seven slide transitions, view transitions, forward and backward pairs, slide-ng-motion and hand-drawn marks.

title: Magic Move Stories
blurb: A cart total refactored in six Shiki Magic Moves: long stories, ranges, side-by-side blocks, snippets and clicks.

title: Monaco and Twoslash
blurb: Editors in slides, diffs, code you can run in JavaScript and TypeScript, and Twoslash types.

title: Polyglot Code
blurb: One API in twenty languages: titles, line steps, diffs, scrolling blocks, snippet regions and code groups.

title: Diagram Zoo
blurb: Mermaid flowcharts, sequences, classes, states, ER diagrams and Gantt charts, in light and dark.

title: Math Lecture
blurb: A 4:3 linear algebra lecture with KaTeX, stepped derivations and draggable vectors.

title: Math Heavy
blurb: Gradient descent: math in titles, derivations one line per click, matrices and footnotes.

title: Markdown Extras
blurb: A site file in markdown: footnotes, GitHub alerts, tables, task lists, keys, heading ids, image sizes, imported slides and HTML with markdown inside.

title: Layouts and Sizes
blurb: Every built-in layout on a square 1:1 canvas, from cover to iframe, with a table of contents per section.

title: Layouts and Sizes Portrait
blurb: The same layouts on a 9:16 portrait canvas, for phones and vertical screens.

title: Presenter and Drawing
blurb: A talk about giving talks: presenter notes with clicks, a countdown, drawing, the laser pointer, custom keys and remote control.

title: All Setup Hooks
blurb: One slide per setup hook: Shiki, KaTeX, transformers, a preparser, Mermaid, Monaco, custom code runners, keys and the right-click menu.

title: Theme Switcher
blurb: A talk on edge caching that builds unchanged with any of the five themes.

title: Typography History
blurb: A short history of type in the paper theme: a contents page, marks, footnotes and a type specimen.

title: Recipes Zine
blurb: A kitchen zine with its own recipe layout, a running footer layer and reader notes in four scripts.

title: Brand Deck
blurb: A brand guide for an invented roastery: its own layouts, fonts, a custom pipe and a PDF download.

title: Forest Carbon Report
blurb: A field report in the moss theme: KaTeX, Mermaid charts, a live plot table and a custom pipe.

title: Architecture Review
blurb: An architecture review: topology diagrams, code imported from files, Twoslash and an outbox refactor.

title: Conference Keynote
blurb: A keynote on Angular performance with a stamp addon, review notes, PWA install and a PDF download.

title: Product Update
blurb: A quarterly product update that uses every built-in layout: big numbers, quotes, charts and a live changelog.

title: Ship It
blurb: How a talk ships as a site, a PDF, an offline folder and an installable app, and how this gallery goes out to GitHub Pages.

title: RTL and Languages
blurb: A transit plan in Arabic: right-to-left slides with left-to-right code, plus Japanese, German and Hebrew pages.

title: Edge Cases
blurb: Long titles, long lists, wide tables, braces, entities and file names with spaces, all laid out cleanly.
